newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish debt weakens on EMU fears.
newsitem.headline: Swedish debt weakens on EMU fears.

text.p: Swedish long debt yields inched further up in early trade on Friday, pushed by fears over monetary union, sparked by the forthcoming French elections.
"Sweden is not at all in focus. We are unable to decrease the spread versus Germany unless something positive comes out," one chief dealer said.
"I think that people just do not want to be long ahead of the weekend and what might come out from the newspapers then," one chief dealer said.
Foreign markets were weaker after the close of the Swedish market on Thursday and that set the tone for the day.
Six-month T-bill rates rose three basis points to 4.18 percent and 10-year bond yields were up nine basis points to 7.33 percent.
The spread between Swedish and German debt yields was flat at 137 basis points.
The crown lost substantially to 4.4830 against the D-mark from 4.4620 late on Thursday.
